name: post.job_unknown
description: The scheduler's word that a job's send was cut off: it may or may not have gone out. The job fails and a person checks the account before anyone retries; a retry needs a new yes.
sql: update brandbase.post_jobs j set status = 'failed', error = 'Interrupted. Check the account before you retry.', updated_at = now() where j.id = :input::jsonb ->> 'job' and j.brand_id = :input::jsonb ->> 'brand' and j.status = 'scheduled' returning j.id, j.status, j.error
